name: Crossbars
description: Rules on three axes sixty degrees apart, so the holes come out triangular.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 5%, transparent 5% 20%), repeating-linear-gradient(60deg, #000 0 5%, transparent 5% 20%), repeating-linear-gradient(120deg, #000 0 5%, transparent 5% 20%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 5%, transparent 5% 20%), repeating-linear-gradient(60deg, #000 0 5%, transparent 5% 20%), repeating-linear-gradient(120deg, #000 0 5%, transparent 5% 20%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
